name: Queen of Pentacles
meaning_for_today: Do not allow other people to manipulate you. Right now, everything depends on you, so just consistently carry out your work and remember long-term projects. A meeting with a woman who possesses strong maternal instincts and kindness is not excluded; this woman can play an important role in your fate, and it is worth listening to what she says.
card_advice: You need to be guided by your own opinions and judgments, and under no circumstances allow other people to influence your train of thought. Any business should be done calmly, without fuss, and most importantly, with a measured and consistent pace of action. Do not focus exclusively on work duties, as everyday chores are no less significant.

upright.general: Indicates maturity, experience, common sense, endurance, serenity, and fertility. It brings stability, tranquility, patience, and foresight. A person's labors are appreciated, and they know how to find pleasure even in daily tasks. It usually describes an older woman with excellent maternal instincts—a good homemaker, empathetic mother, and caring spouse. She values the safety of material assets, stable income, strong family ties, and home comfort. It brings pleasant chores related to purchases, household management, manual labor, and making a cozy atmosphere.
upright.in_love: The person shows a warm, cordial, and loyal nature. In marriage, they receive sensory pleasure. The card signifies a feeling of protection or a strong desire for it. It indicates readiness for marriage, such as when a man is ready to propose to his beloved woman without worrying about comfort, as everything is already settled. The couple will joyfully dream together and successfully manifest those dreams. Past relationship problems will shift for the better.
upright.in_situation: The person shows a strong character under various circumstances, acting deliberately and responsibly, even taking on complex projects. They are ready to patiently and systematically follow set goals. Reflects a prudent and organized worker who demonstrates mastery, insight, and a creative approach to professional tasks. High qualifications are shown without large ambitions—the main goal is order, stability, and reliability to be confident in tomorrow. A conscientious and excellent worker who can handle high positions but does not aggressively compete for power.

reversed.general: The person does not seek to develop or improve, and sometimes even degrades, both in grand areas and daily routines. It can indicate a poor homemaker who hasn't developed culinary skills, or someone who fears anything new and refuses to understand it. This impracticality can lead to lost opportunities or even poverty. The person constantly looks back, listens to other people's opinions, and depends on outside advice. Generally responsible for a lack of accountability, suspiciousness, distrustfulness, and carelessness, lacking logic and common sense.
reversed.in_love: Characterized by excessive overprotection, complexes caused by self-doubt, and intimate problems. The person feels insecure, cannot control their emotions, and their constant grievances against their partner prevent happiness. They feel that their loved one doesn't give them proper attention, causing frequent mood swings. If it falls for a man, he will stall and hesitate to propose or marry, believing the right moment hasn't arrived, even though he tries to portray a successful and harmonious personal life to outsiders.
reversed.in_situation: Indicates an irresponsible individual prone to shifting their duties onto others. They are lazy, unable to work methodically and systematically, and lack motivation. The person harbors unjustified claims and high self-esteem, expecting more but receiving less than desired. Due to a sharp tongue and unrestrained expressions, they harm themselves in many situations (at work, at home). They are often hasty and impatient, which has a destructive impact on their affairs.

major.04: The fruits of economy and practicality
major.11: Taking advantage of the right time or season
major.12: Receiving what is fair by justice
major.17: Wastefulness; budget is bursting at the seams
major.18: Dreams that have solid ground beneath them

wands.09: Patience at the limit of possibilities
